title: Offline import verification contract — F1-E
description: Defines the source-only checks tools/fusion must perform against frozen receipts. The tool never talks to devices, ADB, 22222, 17920, or 17930.
checks: current HEAD:services/<dir> listing matches receipt.originalTreeListing (path/mode/type/oid) after subtracting docs/fusion/post-import-allowlist.v1.json exact paths
post-import allowlist never permits missing imported files or runtimeCutoverAllowed=true
allowedBlobModified does not swallow mode mismatches
fusionMergeCommit is a 2-parent ancestor of HEAD
rewrittenTipCommit is parent 2 of fusionMergeCommit and an ancestor of HEAD
history probes remain reachable via git log --follow
